title: Single-writer ownership (P23)
description: A data carrier declares the producers allowed to write it; readers never re-derive a producer's data. P23 asks for exactly one writer: a set of more than one is a named exception in the chart, and gate:dataflow holds the code to whatever set is declared.

writers.description: unique-ids of the nodes allowed to write this carrier.

match.description: Regular expression over the carrier key that gate:dataflow uses to attribute writes in code.

op.description: The write operation gate:dataflow attributes; gate:dataflow refuses an op it cannot see.
